title: Unprecedented Octanuclear DyIII Cluster Exhibiting Single-Molecule Magnet Behavior

material_class.structural_family: two fused [Dy4(μ3-OH)4] cubane units linked by a planar μ4-oxide

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, triethylamine (36 μL, 0.25 mmol) was added to a stirred suspension of Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (114 mg, 0.25 mmol) and H2vht (51 mg, 0.125 mmol) in 95% ethanol (10 mL). After several minutes the mixture became dark brown and was stirred for 16 hours, then filtered through Celite into a vial, sealed, and left to stand at room temperature. After 3 days, black plate-shaped crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction were obtained. The H2vht ligand was prepared according to a previous publication without further modifications. Triethylamine was dried with KOH, distilled, and stored over Linde type 4A molecular sieves; other chemicals were used as received.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature (crystallization); stirring not further specified
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic stirring in ethanol, filtration through Celite into a sealed vial, standing crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered through Celite into a vial, sealed and left to stand at room temperature; black plate-shaped crystals after 3 days

properties.summary: Octanuclear Dy8 cubane-linked cluster is an SMM with zero-field slow magnetic relaxation. Room-temperature χT = 112.3 cm3 K mol−1 (theory 113.36). χT decreases to 80.0 cm3 K mol−1 below 25 K, consistent with Stark depopulation and/or weak antiferromagnetic coupling. Magnetization saturates at 40.1 μB (expected 41.8 μB). Arrhenius fits give Ueff/kB = 7.8(1) K, τ0 = 3.842(9)×10−5 s at 0 Oe and Ueff/kB = 20.4(7) K, τ0 = 6.344(6)×10−6 s at 1500 Oe. Relaxation is dominated by QTM and Raman rather than Orbach; Raman/QTM fit under 1500 Oe: τQTM = 2.755(3)×10−3 s, C = 2.0(2) s−1 K−n, n = 4.31(1). Clear χ″ peaks observed up to 7 K.
